blocks.text: Bring a curated mix of modern comfort and vintage character to your kitchen island or home bar with the Valebeck swivel barstool. Designed for everyday meals, casual entertaining and relaxed conversations, this counter height stool blends warm wood tones, sturdy metal and soft upholstery for lasting style and support. The smooth swivel seat makes it easy to turn toward guests or prep areas, while the supportive back encourages longer, more comfortable sitting. Ideal for kitchens, open‑concept dining spaces and breakfast bars, it pairs effortlessly with kitchen island seating, bar chairs and other kitchen stools.

items.label: CASUAL-INDUSTRIAL STYLE BAR STOOL
items.value: Crafted with wood, engineered wood and metal, this barstool adds visual depth and durability, making it a stylish upgrade for bar stools around a kitchen island or casual dining area

items.label: COMFORTABLE SWIVEL BAR STOOLS
items.value: Comfy cushioned seat with linen‑colored polyester upholstery and a smooth 360‑degree swivel lets you turn easily, perfect for conversation, prep time and everyday dining

items.label: FUNCTIONAL STOOLS FOR KITCHEN ISLAND
items.value: Nailhead trim and a supportive back elevate comfort and style, giving you reliable seating that works beautifully as stools for kitchen counter spaces and breakfast bars

items.label: PERFECT SIZE
items.value: This bar stool measures 19.5" W x 19.5" D x 37" H, offering a balanced counter height barstool profile that fits most counters while providing stability and comfort for daily use

items.label: READY FOR EASY SETUP
items.value: Ideal for kitchens, dining nooks and casual entertaining spaces, this swivel chair complements other barstools, stools and kitchen chairs; assembly required
